title: Why a directory walk can miss allocated data
method: Fictional filesystem example before the final descriptor closes: 200 MiB named data + 600 MiB unlinked but open log = 800 MiB. Metadata, compression, snapshots and reserved space are excluded.
alt: Why a directory walk can miss allocated data. Named file data: 200 MiB; Open unlinked log: 600 MiB. Illustrative inputs.
